title: Hiss
source: Torqwave Synth: Concrete Pad's chords under Cold Bell's arpeggio, four bars at 120 BPM, after a second of the noise alone
damage: white noise at -38 dBFS RMS over the whole clip
repair: Effects > Noise Reduction and Repair > Noise Reduction: the print taken from the first second, then the whole clip reduced by 12 dB (the default) and by 24 dB

title: Mains hum
source: Torqwave Synth: Concrete Pad's chords under Cold Bell's arpeggio, four bars at 120 BPM
damage: a 50 Hz hum with five harmonics: the fundamental at -34 dBFS, each harmonic 6 dB under the one before
repair: Effects > Noise Reduction and Repair > Remove Hum at its defaults (50 Hz, 8 harmonics, Q 30)

title: Missing highs
source: The factory kit EBM Kit (Industrial/EBM), its loop twice, as the Sequence Library plays it
damage: everything over 5 kHz filtered away (eight 12 dB low-pass sections in a row at 5 kHz)
repair: Effects > Noise Reduction and Repair > Spectral Recovery at its defaults (the cutoff found from the audio, level -3 dB, rebuilt up to 16 kHz)

title: Loudness
source: The factory kit EBM Kit (Industrial/EBM), its loop twice, as the Sequence Library plays it
damage: nothing: the loop as the instruments made it
repair: Effects > Dynamics > Maximizer: Balanced, ceiling -1 dBTP, its gain set so the clip measures -10 LUFS
